## Drop-off centre
The Contoso Recycling Centre is at 4500 River Road. It accepts household recycling drop-offs Tuesday through Saturday from 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.

## Before visiting
Visitors should sort paper, containers, and cardboard before arriving. Hazardous waste is not accepted at this location.
